comments.author: metamorcat
comments.body_html:
Hi, I’m still playing on 3.9 so I really enjoy this mod. thanks for the great mod!

However, seems like this mod has some bugs. One of them is that m16s won’t appear on flea market.

I spent hours to fix this issue. I’ll share the fix in return for the great mod.

M16s won’t appear on flea, this is because the codes in “globals.json” are not correctly written. The default presets aren’t definied.

Rewrite the first two presets in globals.json, like,

“4D4350524553455449461000”: {

“_encyclopedia“: “weapon_colt_m16a4(RO905)_556x45”,

“_id“: “4D4350524553455449461000”,

“_type“: “Preset”,

“_changeWeaponName“: false,

and

“4D4350524553455449471000”: {

“_encyclopedia“: “weapon_colt_m16a4(RO901)_556x45”,

“_id“: “4D4350524553455449471000”,

“_type“: “Preset”,

“_changeWeaponName“: false,

then M16s will appear on flea.

ALSO, you gotta delete the inappropriate parts from the M16 presets, because they aren’t written correctly and will cause serious errors(the client will be loading forever when you buy M16 on flea). For example, one of the presets has the MBUS iron sight, and this is a residue from the Honey Badger MOD, which CANNOT BE attached to the M16. Give the M16A1 iron sight (sight_rear_ar15_colt_m16a1_rear_sight_std) to it instead. In addition, there’re some more wrong parts that need to be deleted in the 4 presets.

lastly, buy some M16s on flea and check if everything’s fine.

DONE, it’s fixed!
